info.title: pgembed
info.description: Run PostgreSQL locally without installing it: named instances of any version in the background, SQL with readable results and errors, schema inspection, SQL formatting, and an MCP server for AI assistants. Built on MysticMind.PostgresEmbed.

commands.name: mcp
commands.description: Run an MCP server over standard input and output, for AI assistants

options.name: --read-only
options.description: Refuse anything that writes, on every target

options.name: --no-confirm
options.description:
Run changes, kills and removals without asking (for
sandboxes and throwaway agents)

options.name: --allow-external-writes
options.description:
Allow writes to servers pgembed did not start (named
connections and connection strings); read-only otherwise

options.name: --statement-timeout
options.description:
Seconds a statement may run before it is cancelled (default
120; 0 for none)

options.name: --least-privilege
options.description:
Connect to pgembed instances as a role that is not a
superuser (PostgreSQL 14+): it reads, writes and creates,
but cannot reach files, programs or libraries, even through
functions; it cannot alter tables the superuser owns

options.name: --connection
options.description:
A server the assistant can use by name without seeing its
connection string or password, for example --connection
prod=postgresql://me@db/shop. Repeatable

options.description:
Require a password for TCP connections, for shared machines: pgembed
